hooks.command: LAST_CLAUDE_COMMIT=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null); HIST_CHANGED=""; if [ -n "$LAST_CLAUDE_COMMIT" ]; then HIST_CHANGED=$(git log "$LAST_CLAUDE_COMMIT"..HEAD --name-only --pretty=format: -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.js' '*.jsx' 'package.json' ':!*/node_modules/*' ':!*/dist/*' ':!*/build/*' ':!*/.next/*' 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$|(^|/)package\.json$'); fi; WT_CHANGED=$(git status --porcelain -- . ':!CLAUDE.md' ':!*/node_modules/*' ':!*/dist/*' ':!*/build/*' ':!*/.next/*' 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$|(^|/)package\.json$'); WT_CLAUDE_CHANGED=$(git status --porcelain -- CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$WT_CLAUDE_CHANGED" ]; then echo '{}'; elif [ -n "$HIST_CHANGED" ] || [ -n "$WT_CHANGED" ]; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Hay cambios de codigo (.ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/package.json), commiteados o no, que no se reflejaron en CLAUDE.md. Revisa si CLAUDE.md necesita actualizarse (nuevos componentes, rutas, dependencias o decisiones de arquitectura) antes de terminar."}'; else echo '{}'; fi
